question: Can the selected source speech help without the factual errors introduced by generated note text?

conditions.input: Full causal transcript and user question.
conditions.difference: No saved notes; reproduce the existing baseline.

conditions.input: The same full transcript and question, plus the exact saved native-call notes.
The same transcript and question, plus only the original source passages selected by those notes.
conditions.difference: Remove generated facts, owner/status labels, links and change summaries; keep the same source IDs.

conditions.input: The same transcript and question, plus current source passages and earlier evidence for the same active notes.
conditions.difference: Recover source links overwritten by updates; use only pre-request edits and a 4,096-token quote budget.

common.output: The same brief JSON answer, evidence_ids and missing_information.
common.transcript: Retain the full causal ground-truth speaker-attributed transcript in every condition.
common.prompt: Keep the existing answer instructions unchanged; change only saved_results.
common.control: Reproduce reactive/current-note runs; two sources-only views introduce no request-aware note selection.
common.budget: Same 4,096-token ceiling; shorter views are not padded, and actual input tokens are reported.
common.cost: Charge the same 434,979 existing writer-output tokens once to each note-based production scenario; this diagnostic introduces no new writer, so it tests representation, not cheaper note generation.

preflight.evaluation_gate: Every pilot answer requires source review; automatic full-bank scaling is not released.

gates.action: Source-review every pilot answer using the frozen fact checklists.
gates.criterion: The automatic judge did not qualify; no new accuracy is released before all 144 answers are reviewed.

gates.action: Prepare the four inputs and verify causality, source copying, context limits and reproduced prompt hashes.
gates.criterion: Seven CPU behavior tests,420 inputs and 210 recorded baseline/current-note prompt hashes pass.

gates.action: Run 12 familiar diagnostic questions with four conditions, both thinkers and two Thinking seeds.
gates.criterion: 126/144 answers saved; four conditions and both thinker models.

gates.action: Freeze the implementation after the pilot, then retain all 105 questions for the matched comparison.
gates.criterion: No tuning on the full-run outputs; this reused bank is not an unseen test set.

evaluation.primary: Fully supported answer accuracy and request-time native thinking tokens, with per-meeting paired confidence intervals.
additional: Median and mean thinking tokens; cap-hit and missing-answer rates.
Cold serial H100 first-answer and completion time; report missing answers separately.
Actual input tokens and total generated tokens including earlier notes, errors and retries.
Descriptive correct-in-both and cap-excluded analyses alongside all-case primary results.
evaluation.targets: A useful candidate preserves accuracy within a predeclared 2 percentage-point margin, reduces mean thinking tokens by at least 15 percent and first-answer time by at least 10 percent, with paired intervals supporting the improvement; these are targets, not observed results.

stages.roles: Judge weights and 8 GiB KV on GPU 0
stages.dependency: Source-review cases and routing checks ready.

stages.roles: Thinker weights and 8 GiB KV on GPU 0
stages.dependency: Manual source review of every pilot answer replaces automatic scorer qualification.

stages.GPU: A100 80 GB (bounded pilot); H100 timing study remains a later gate
stages.roles: Thinker weights and 8 GiB KV on GPU 0; cold serial requests
stages.dependency: Instruct stage completes; no shared GPU services.

stages.roles: Review every answer against past source speech; automatic judge unqualified

resources.sharing: Text jobs are sequential; one separate audio lane is also authorized, maximum two study GPUs overall.

later: Only if quote-only inputs preserve quality should a separate question-blind writer be tested that saves source IDs and event links without rewriting factual claims.
